findings.summary: This run threads WorldModelConfig.seed into each agent's WorldModel via deriveSeed(seed, agentIndex) — the same pattern 2026-08-13-paired-init-instrument-validation established, applied here to the arm-a-instrument-validation milestone's own naming/framing for the first time. weightInitDiagnostic below is the once-only reproducibility check: sameSeedIdentical:true / differentSeedDiffers:true is the pass condition, inverted from the 2026-08-12 baseline's identical:false (which predates WorldModelConfig.seed's existence).

weightInitDiagnostic.claim: buildWorldModels(seed, ...) called twice with the same seed draws identical per-agent initial weights; called with a different seed still draws different ones. sameSeedIdentical:true / differentSeedDiffers:true is the pass condition (inverted from 2026-08-12's unseeded identical:false).
